question: Do publicly measured pathology-authenticated EMC specimens show a replicated informative absolute and relative macrophage versus T-cell tissue composition contrast beyond the already published sparse EMC macrophage/TIL phenotype?
before_values: New tissue cell-count values not yet inspected; known R1/R3/R8 findings reused at original scope. Source eligibility, novelty and all-condition mapping gate before any new numerical comparison.
eligibility: Clinical source pathology labels retained at actual confidence, molecular authentication only where stated; generic sarcoma/chondrosarcoma unresolved. Each donor, site, treatment/preservation, compartment, core/ROI and assay denominator retained. All eligible EMC observations and independent same-protocol comparators required.
markers: CD68 and CD163 macrophages separately; CD3 and CD8 T cells separately. Do not combine total TIL with marker-specific Tcells or assume these markers establish polarized function.
controls: Within-study same-protocol myxoidliposarcoma, synovialsarcoma and LGFMS if present, plus all other histotypes and lowgrade/translocation-associated sensitivity; report missing controls, no selected favorable comparator.
scores: Each marker absolute cells/mm2 and donor-level fraction M/(M+T) for appropriately matched compartments/fields; total zero denominator is undefined, not zero. M/T displayed only for nonzero T with zero/nearzero denominators explicit. No invented density from percent-area/ordinal scores; do not pool incompatible units. Core/ROI averaged or hierarchically retained, never counted as donors.
uncertainty: Donor resampling or exact rank-based contrast with all absolute distributions and uncertainty; at least one independent compatible cohort for replication. Small n, grade/site/treatment/preservation and core sampling limit conclusions; no arbitrary significance threshold turns a descriptive catalogue into a finding.
strongest_alternatives: Published translocation/low-grade sarcoma pattern, rather than informative EMC composition
Near-zero Tcell denominator inflates relative TAM score despite low absolute macrophages
Grade, cellularity/myxoidmatrix, site, prior therapy, preservation and compartment/core sampling
Markers do not establish cell function; spatial/core technical subsamples are not independent donors; between-study overlap unknown
defeat: Original studies already answer claimed contrast; no individual authenticated matched absolute cell counts; only qualitative/aggregate results or incompatible compartments/units; accessible suitable pending conditions; effect fails absolute-density/control/replication/value reassessment.
next_measurement_if_survives: Prespecified matched-area multi-marker counts in independent molecularly confirmed EMC and lowgrade/translocation controls with tumor-cellularity and whole-section/core sensitivity, before any mechanism or treatment experiment.
